attributes.purpose: Owners (parties: parties.py display_name/operator), change records, incidents and work instructions; import runs and collection attempts; the unknowns register (ciamUnknown questions the planner counts: check_unknowns, report unknowns); ITSM ticket evidence (tickets.py: ciamTicketRef on ciamChange, observed ciamTicket under ou=<adapter>,ou=tickets, drift states, check_tickets, report tickets; never an approval); stale-runbook view and report.

attributes.description: Distribution opsdir-adapter-servicenow (import opsdir_adapter_servicenow), registered via entry point opsdir.adapters:servicenow; depends on opsdir.
attributes.purpose: ServiceNow as an ITSM add-on (kind itsm): reads the change tickets the record's change records link (servicenow:<number>) as evidence (importer servicenow/change-requests from Table API answers or JSON list exports of change_request + sysapproval_approver, raw UTC values, state map keyed by change model via setting servicenow-standard-state-models); read-only collector paging GET /api/now/table/... until an empty page with basic or bearer credentials.

attributes.description: Read-only linkage of recorded changes (ciamChange.ciamTicketRef '<adapter>:<number>') to their ITSM tickets: an ITSM add-on's importer (offline export or read-only collector via ciamCollectionSource) records each linked ticket as observed evidence (ciamTicket under cn=<number>,ou=<adapter>,ou=tickets: neutral state, aggregate approval, planned/work windows, approver rows, raw facts, provider id), never under ou=changes and never as an approval opsdir acts on; governance/tickets.py reconciles record vs ticket (in-step, not-imported, rejected, cancelled, unapproved, closed-pending, live-but-rejected, window-differs, outside-window): planner check check_tickets (blockers rejected/cancelled, actions otherwise, silent with no tickets) and report `tickets`. ServiceNow first (opsdir-adapter-servicenow, kind itsm).

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.purpose: How a party is named in correspondence: its ciamDisplayName, else its RDN value.

attributes.name: operator
attributes.purpose: The party under ou=owners that operates the platform (ciamOwnerKind operator), or None.

attributes.name: ticket_ref
attributes.purpose: The (adapter, number) a change record's ciamTicketRef '<adapter>:<number>' names, or None.

attributes.name: adapter_dn
attributes.purpose: DN of the branch holding the tickets one ITSM add-on read (ou=<adapter>,ou=tickets).

attributes.name: ticket_dn
attributes.purpose: DN of a ticket an ITSM add-on read (cn=<number>,ou=<adapter>,ou=tickets).

attributes.name: linked_changes
attributes.purpose: Every change record under ou=changes naming a ticket (ciamTicketRef), by name.

attributes.name: linked_numbers
attributes.purpose: The ticket numbers the record's changes name for one ITSM add-on, each once, in change order: what its importer reads and its collector requests.

attributes.name: tickets
attributes.purpose: Every ciamTicket the record holds under ou=tickets (as last read).

attributes.name: ticket_entry
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "required": true}, {"name": "adapter", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "number", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "at", "type": "str", "required": true, "description": "GeneralizedTime the export was taken"}, {"name": "facts", "type": "dict", "required": true, "description": "{attribute of TICKET_ATTRS: value, tuple for multi-valued, None when unsaid}"}]
attributes.purpose: A ticket's ciamTicket entry as an importer read it at a time: the ticket attributes it owns (TICKET_ATTRS) from facts, anything else the record adds (owners) kept; never a change record attribute.

attributes.name: ticket_group
attributes.purpose: The import group of one ticket: its own DN and entry, so an import replaces only that ticket and never removes another.

attributes.name: window_differs
attributes.purpose: Whether the UTC day the record plans the change (ciamPlannedAt) is outside the days of the ticket's planned window (an end the ticket doesn't give is open).

attributes.name: outside_window
attributes.purpose: Whether ITSM says the work ran outside the ticket's own planned window: actual start before planned start, or actual end after planned end (exact UTC times).

attributes.name: drift_states
attributes.purpose: The drift states of a change record against its ticket as read (rejected, cancelled, unapproved, closed-pending, live-but-rejected, window-differs, outside-window), or in-step alone; approval judged only from the ticket's overall approval.

attributes.name: linked
attributes.purpose: Every linked change compared with its ticket (Linked): drift states, not-imported when the ticket wasn't read but its system's tickets were, nothing when that system was never read.

attributes.name: finding_text
attributes.purpose: What one drift state of a linked change says in words ('ITSM says': evidence, never the record's approval).

attributes.name: check_tickets
attributes.purpose: Governance planner check: blockers for linked changes whose ticket ITSM says was rejected or cancelled while the record approves them, actions (for the change's owner, else the operator) for the other drift, in-step changes as fine; silent while the record holds no ticket; no fixes.

attributes.name: ticket_rows
attributes.purpose: Rows of the `tickets` report: per linked change, its record status and planned day, the ticket, ITSM's state (with native), approval, planned and work windows, when read and the drift.

attributes.name: answer_rows
attributes.purpose: The records of one ServiceNow answer ({'result': [...]} Table API or {'records': [...]} JSON list export), or none and why (an error answer, not an answer).

attributes.name: display_only
attributes.purpose: Why a change_request record can't be compared: its state or window times are display text (unknown time zone) rather than raw values; None when raw.

attributes.name: neutral_state
attributes.purpose: A ticket's neutral state from the standard state model map when its chg_model (sys_id or name) is one the operator names as standard, else None and the model's description for a notice.
attributes.returns: {"type": "tuple", "description": "(neutral state or None, unnamed model text or None)"}

attributes.name: approver_rows
attributes.purpose: The sysapproval_approver records of one change as ciamTicketApprover values '<state> <approver sys_id> updated <time>' (IDs, never names), sorted.

attributes.name: ticket_facts
attributes.purpose: The ticket attributes (governance TICKET_ATTRS) of one raw change_request record: title, sys_id as ciamProviderRef, Table API record URL when the instance is known, neutral state, overall approval, native state, windows, approver rows, raw facts.

attributes.name: read_changes
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "files", "type": "dict[str, str]", "required": true}, {"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "required": true}, {"name": "patterns", "type": "tuple", "required": true}, {"name": "at", "type": "datetime | None", "required": false, "description": "when the export was taken (required)"}]
attributes.purpose: Importer servicenow/change-requests: each ticket the record links that the export holds, its own import group under ou=servicenow,ou=tickets; notices for unlinked tickets, linked ones missing (never removed), display-only records, unknown models, fields never carried, error answers, several instances.

attributes.name: answer_fields
attributes.purpose: A Request keep function: what opsdir collect keeps of a Table API answer, each record's requested fields only (non-answers kept as they are).

attributes.name: page_path
attributes.purpose: Export path of one collected page: <host>/<table>/<chunk>-<offset>.json.

attributes.name: change_steps
attributes.purpose: Collector steps: each chunk of linked tickets' change_request pages (each page after a non-empty one), then, once every chunk ended on an empty page, the sysapproval_approver pages of the sys_ids found; GETs only.

attributes.name: source_problems
attributes.purpose: Why the environment's servicenow/change-requests collection sources can't be read: their own problems, or a credential scheme other than basic or bearer.

attributes.description: A linked change compared with its ticket: the ciamChange, the adapter and number its ciamTicketRef names, the ticket entry as last read (None: not read) and its drift states (none: that system's tickets were never read).
